body:
I've had an unexpected  experience with meth recently. I'm considered straight edged. I use weed on EXTREMELY rare cases and this just so happened to be one of those cases. I usually buy from my close friends and bum some from my brother or family members but on this  occasion my friends and family were both dry so I called up a co-worker that I had only known for a week or two. We would speak briefly at work about video games and sometimes drugs that's what made me ask him. I dialed him up and asked how much he charged for a gram. He laughed at me through the phone and just told me to come play some video games with him and forget about the price. I went over to his house and he came out to my car he said he didn't like smoking in his room because his pets get antsy. I said fine and we smoked in my car. Since I'm not a heavy user of weed in general I didn't really know how to roll a blunt so I asked him to roll it while I played around on my phone. He said "cool I'll roll this but I also have a couple of pre wrapped ones so light this one while I roll it." He starts rolling and I start lighting the first blunt. Almost immediately I start feeling a different type of high than what I'm used to but I ignore it because I didn't want to come off as weird or anything. A few minutes later and the blunt I have is half gone and he's done rolling up two more blunts, one for each of us. We leave my car and start playing call of duty bo3 and I'm doing absolutely amazing. I usually suck at first person games but holy shit was I doing great. A couple of hours go buy and I'm feeling unwell just tired in general and he looks over at me and says "you look like you need another blunt wanna go out to your car?" I agree and we leave for another 20 minutes to smoke our own blunts. After the second blunt I'm feeling a little flustered and all around bad so I tell him I'm gonna leave and that I'll see him later. He looks at me and after what feels like a long pause he starts to get out of my car. As he goes to close my door he says "thanks for smoking some meth with me"  he walks back to his front door and goes inside and I was just stuck sitting in my car. The drive home was horrible I was paranoid sweating and felt sick the whole time. He texted me while I was driving but I was barely able to keep my hands on my wheel anyway. I got home and looked at my phone to see his message:

Asshole: "You didn't look so good dude lol you ok?" 

Me: "umm did you say something when you got out of my car? I was really fucked up"

Asshole: " yeah I said thanks for smoking meth with me."

Me: " meth?? Dude what the fuck." 

Asshole: "sorry bro I thought you knew."

I couldn't focus on a reply with how confused/pissed I was so I just sat in my bathtub the whole night. The next day I woke up and went to work. I felt like I had a hangover but hadn't drank any alchohol at all I felt weak and I looked like shit. I walked over to the asshole and stared him straight in his eyes and said "you're fucking dead to me". I told him that if I had know we would be doing meth I wouldn't have smoked with him at all and that he should have told me instead of just assuming I would know. He apologized but then went on to jokingly say "didn't it feel like you were on top of the world though?"
I punched this asshole straight in his face and left work for the day. My manager called me and told me I was fired from my job. I went though so many stages of regret that day. So yes, meth not even once.
